hypothesis: Rewrite month equality as a range; test whether the optimizer already handles it.

queries.routes:
SELECT Dest AS dimension, COUNT(*) AS flights, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed_arrivals,
    SUM(ArrDelay) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions
FROM data WHERE Month >= {{month}} AND Month <= {{month}} AND Origin = {{origin}}
GROUP BY Dest
